correctness.rationale: The matrix K_D exactly matches Gao-Yuan 2024 Eq. (4.4) after factoring constant homogeneous rates. For PF y>0, flow balance makes sum_i(Dy)_i/(y_i/v_i) a nonnegative relative-entropy sum; strict unless y is proportional to v. Groupwise Cauchy-Schwarz yields mu rho(K_D)>=M. Equality plus eigenvector proportionality and the P^T diag(h)(q-M1)=0 identity force q=1; conversely q=1 gives unit K_D column sums after multiplication by mu. Explicit irreducible D_k=k(v1^T-I) yields mu(mu I-D_k)^-1->v1^T, hence the infimum M. Exact two-group algebra independently reproduced using rational standard-library verifier with VERIFY_OK. No finite computational sampling is used as proof for arbitrary n.

Comparisons to 2019 Eulerian, 2024 Lagrangian, 2025 migration and published mathematical research records found no implication-equivalent theorem; Gao-Cao 2024 full-text access remained unavailable.

value.rationale: The fixed-v sharp infimum provides a meaningful structural limit on how much vector mobility alone can suppress epidemic transmission, with the exact intrinsic penalty 1+Var_h(q). Nonattainment for every finite migration rate when heterogeneous group exposure persists and the complete q=1 equality locus resolve a motivated explicit gap in the 2024 paper. The role of nonproportional patch host/vector distributions has biological interpretation and is not a numerical curiosity; the theorem is stronger than, and structurally distinct from, the already known standalone Cauchy-Schwarz inequality.
